tools.name: pinflower_cancel_order
tools.description: Use this when the buyer explicitly asks to cancel an order placed here. The website's rules apply: free while the florist has not confirmed, and for a later-day order until the cut-off before its time window; a paid amount is refunded in full. Two steps: order_ref with confirm=true sends a 6-digit c

tools.name: pinflower_check_delivery
tools.description: Use this when the buyer asks whether Pinflower delivers to a place in Prague, how much delivery costs, how soon it can arrive, or whether flowers can come tonight — before choosing a bouquet. Takes the place as the buyer said it. Bouquet search results already include this for their place.

tools.name: pinflower_create_order
tools.description: Use this when the buyer has agreed to the quoted total: it creates the order exactly like the website's checkout and returns the secure payment link on pinflower.cz. tools.name: pinflower_get_order_status
tools.description: Use this when the buyer asks what is happening with an order placed here — whether it is paid, confirmed by the florist, on the way or delivered. Needs the order_ref returned when the order was created. Read-only: it changes nothing.

tools.name: pinflower_new_pay_link
tools.description: Use this when the buyer has not paid yet and the order's payment link expired or got lost: it returns the order's payable link on pinflower.cz — the same one while it is still open (one order, one payable link). Needs the order_ref. Not for paid or cancelled orders.

tools.name: pinflower_quote_order
tools.description: Use this when the buyer has chosen what to order and you have the details: it prices the order exactly as the checkout will charge it — the bouquet(s), add-ons, the shop's launch discount or the buyer's promo code, the delivery fee — and checks the time, without creating anything. Takes: the bouquet
